method: Manual review of all four final PNGs and four evenly spaced decoded frames per final GIF; frame count, duration and encoding integrity are independently checked in media.json.
observations: Actual authenticated Web and Taro interfaces; readable organization totals before and after reconciliation.
Web reconciled capture retains the actual horizontally scrolled ledger position after the reconciliation action; table columns can be scrolled.
Mobile captures show the current summary viewport, not the entire long ledger.
GIFs show actual scope switching after sensitive actions. Passwords, MFA input and private capabilities are outside these recordings.
scope: Synthetic local business data; no provider call, real-device or production acceptance.
